baseline_reuse_policy: one operationally valid canonical baseline-bare-codex provider sample per causal comparison fingerprint and replicate is shared by all treatment comparisons; verifier/review outcomes and execution date do not select the sample
interpretation: Single-run token screening observation only; do not treat one pair as a population estimate. Negative token deltas mean runtime-opencode-codex-product-v1 used fewer provider-reported tokens than the compatible retained baseline. Structured verifier and review outcomes are diagnostic and do not select the pair. Freshish tokens are fresh_input_tokens + output_tokens for a cache-adjusted secondary view.
